disposition_reason: This unit's PASS is justified plainly. All eight frozen criteria are independently met, every manifest hash and byte count recomputes exactly, and unlike most of the cohort the evidence is not synthetic-only: I reproduced the real three-mechanism cross-process sweep from a pristine export of the cohort commit and got byte-equal canonical output for all three. The tests survive three separate stub substitutions including one that removes the second interpreter entirely, so they pin the actual two-process requirement. My additional adversaries - filesystem-carried cross-invocation state, directory traversal, and symlink escape - were all handled correctly. The one non-equivalence I could manufacture (wall-clock output) is required behaviour under this unit's own 'byte for byte' deliverable wording. The producer's single declared limitation is accurate and is a real authority boundary.
